title: Givaudan’s results for first nine months of 2026 bolstered by fine fragrances
summary: The Swiss flavours and fragrance company reported better-than-expected revenue for January to September 2026, driven by growth in its fine fragrances arm

extraction.key_fact: 스위스 향료 기업 지보단이 파인 프래그런스 부문의 성장에 힘입어 예상보다 좋은 실적을 거두었다.
